text:
sara (AE): Hightower legal emailed: they need SOC 2 artifacts + a signed penetration test attestation before we start the POC. Wants everything by next Tue to finalize the SOW. They also asked if customer-managed KMS is possible for the POC and whether that changes pricing.
leo (SalesEng): quick answers: SOC2 excerpt + system description + redacted infra diagram we can share publicly. Full topology and unredacted diagrams require NDA/dataroom. Customer KMS (bring-your-own-key) requires Private deployment (or Redwood Private with KMS integration) — that is a feature/ops uplift.
marta (Security): pen-test attestation: we can produce a templated attestation that outlines scope (external perimeter + app auth flows) and typical remediation window. For signature: we prefer Head of Security or a delegated Director-level sign-off. Legal needs to ok final wording. I can sign if legal delegates.
ellie (SalesOps): pricing impact: Hosted POC = standard usage rates, no extra. Private / dedicated single-tenant + BYOK = one-time onboarding fee + monthly infra lease. I'll produce a ballpark by EOD: two scenarios (7-day burst vs 30-day reserved).
sam (Support): I can assemble the artifact zip and generate a presigned link. Recommend including a short README inside the zip listing files and redaction level. Command I use:```bash
rwd-cli artifacts bundle create --id hightower-17645 --include soc2_excerpt.pdf iso-summary.pdf pen_attestation_template.pdf redacted_topology.png --out hightower-poc-evidence.zip
rwd-cli presign create --file hightower-poc-evidence.zip --ttl 7d
# returns: https://dataroom.internal/presign/hightower-poc-evidence.zip
```
legal-bot: Reminder: any attestation statements referencing audit firm names must be cleared with Legal. Upload draft wording to Legal queue.
ciso@hightower: Confirming scope: 1) SOC2 Type II excerpt (security & confidentiality controls) 2) Pen-test letter specifying scope (external infra + customer-facing API) and signer name+title 3) Statement on whether BYOK/KMS separation is available for POC 4) Redacted and full network topology (full only in NDA dataroom). ZIP link preferred. Also please confirm the cut-off date for the SOC2 audit used.
sara (AE): noted. Hightower wants the SOC2 audit date included — @marta can you pull last audit date and confirm auditor name?
marta (Security): last audit completed 2025-10-12; auditor: NorthPoint Security LLC. I'll draft the attestation with that date and the pen-test template. Legal - please review the draft for naming the auditor.
ellie (SalesOps): Ellie here: provisional numbers: 7-day dedicated burst = +$4,500 one-time (provisioning + reserved infra) + $X per GPU-hour; 30-day reserved = +$12,000/mo baseline. BYOK onboarding = one-time $3,000 for ops & security work. I'll send a spreadsheet.
leo (SalesEng): note for POC topology: we can provide an architecture diagram showing isolated tenant VPC, NAT egress, and no shared KV access. That should satisfy their isolation ask in redacted form. For BYOK we need HSM/KMS handshake details — ops will need a ticket.
sam (Support): Uploaded draft bundle to presign: https://dataroom.internal/presign/hightower-poc-evidence.zip (expires 7d). Contents: SOC2_excerpt.pdf, iso-summary.pdf, pen_attestation_template_draft.pdf, topology_redacted.png, README.txt
legal-bot: Legal queued: review requested for pen_attestation_template_draft.pdf. SLA wording and auditor naming flagged.
sara (AE): I'll confirm with Hightower if they accept a Head of Security signature or require CISO-level. I'll also ask whether NDA is acceptable for full diagrams. Back to you all by 10am PST tomorrow.
marta (Security): I'll be on stand-by to sign after Legal approves. If they insist on third-party pen-test signature, we can provide vendor contact (northpoint-audit@northpointsec.com) and costs/timeline.
ciso@hightower: Thanks everyone. We prefer Head of Security sign-off. NDA is fine for full diagrams. Please include BYOK statement and costs in the quote.
dataroom-bot: Evidence bundle created: hightower-poc-evidence.zip (SOC2_excerpt.pdf, pen_attestation_template_draft.pdf, iso-summary.pdf, topology_redacted.png, README.txt). Link: https://dataroom.internal/presign/hightower-poc-evidence.zip
